description: GO decision table for CACUL1 and BioPlex CUL3 bait interactome showing CACUL1 absence
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
ann=pd.read_csv('cacul1_GO_annotations_quickgo.csv')
bp=pd.read_csv('BioPlex_293T_Network_10K_Dec_2019.tsv', sep='\t')
cul3=sorted(bp.loc[bp.SymbolA=='CUL3','SymbolB'])

verdict={('GO:0031625','IEA'):'refuted as domain inference',
         ('GO:0006511','IEA'):'refuted as domain inference',
         ('GO:0019901','IBA'):'retain',('GO:0019901','IPI'):'retain',
         ('GO:0005515','IPI'):'replace with informative term',
         ('GO:0000082','IBA'):'retain',('GO:0000082','IMP'):'retain',
         ('GO:0008284','IMP'):'retain',('GO:0045860','IMP'):'retain'}
ann['verdict']=[verdict.get((r.goId,r.evidence),'retain') for r in ann.itertuples()]
cmap={'refuted as domain inference':'#e53e3e','replace with informative term':'#dd6b20','retain':'#38a169'}
ann=ann.sort_values(['verdict','goId'])
ann.to_csv('GO_decision_table.csv',index=False)

fig,(ax,ax2)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14.5,6.2),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.55,1]})
y=np.arange(len(ann))[::-1]
for yi,r in zip(y,ann.itertuples()):
    ax.barh(yi,1,color=cmap[r.verdict],alpha=0.18,height=0.82)
    ax.text(0.015,yi,f'{r.goId}  {r.goName}',va='center',fontsize=8.5)
    ax.text(0.70,yi,f'{r.evidence}',va='center',fontsize=8.5,ha='center')
    ax.text(0.80,yi,f'{r.assignedBy}',va='center',fontsize=8)
    ax.text(0.985,yi,r.verdict,va='center',fontsize=8,ha='right',color=cmap[r.verdict],weight='bold')
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,len(ann)-0.2); ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.text(0.70,len(ann)-0.45,'evidence',fontsize=8.5,ha='center',style='italic')
ax.text(0.80,len(ann)-0.45,'assigned by',fontsize=8.5,style='italic')
ax.text(0.985,len(ann)-0.45,'this analysis',fontsize=8.5,ha='right',style='italic')
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax.set_title('A  Current GO annotations for CACUL1 (QuickGO, UniProtKB:Q86Y37)\n    The two InterPro IEA terms come from IPR001373 "Cullin, N-terminal"',loc='left',fontsize=10.5)

ax2.barh(range(len(cul3)), [1]*len(cul3), color='#4299e1', alpha=0.75, height=0.72)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(cul3))); ax2.set_yticklabels(cul3, fontsize=7)
ax2.set_xticks([]); ax2.set_xlim(0,1.5)
ax2.text(1.05, len(cul3)/2, 'CACUL1 absent\nfrom this list\nand from the\nwhole 13,957-protein\n293T network',
         fontsize=9, color='#c53030', va='center', weight='bold')
for s in ax2.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax2.set_title('B  BioPlex 293T: 31 preys recovered with CUL3 as bait\n    (every major BTB adaptor plus NEDD8, ARIH1, CSN subunits)',loc='left',fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(ann[['goId','goName','aspect','evidence','assignedBy','reference','verdict']].to_string(index=False))
